task.description: GH #566 / ISS-0617: TC-EXP-601-01 ('quota policy resolves the effective profile from the active config surface') asserts the resolved profile's max_entity_records_total is 10 (a deliberately small test override) but gets 200000 (the evident platform default) instead. TC-EXP-601-02, 03, 04 (quota middleware rejection tests for entity/file/sandbox-allocation writes) fail downstream of the same misresolved profile. Not yet root-caused -- genuinely new, no SQL error correlates with this test's timestamp window (pure application-logic mismatch, not a query failure). Read tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig (all 4 test blocks) and find the tier-profile/quota resolution code (search src/ for 'tier_profile', 'quota', 'max_entity_records_total', or similar) in full. Trace the actual resolution path from config source to the resolver's return value -- determine whether this is a lookup-key mismatch (e.g. wrong tenant_id used), a missing seed row in the test fixture, or a config-precedence bug. Actually run the failing test to observe the failure directly (not just read code) -- export BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test and BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5452/bpm_dev (workspace r-co-2's port band, already healthy), check build.zig for a scoped step (search 'exp601'), add temporary debug output if needed to trace runtime behavior, then revert any temporary debug code before finishing.
acceptance_criteria: The tier-profile override resolution path traced from config source to the resolver return value, with file:line precision
Root cause identified as lookup-key mismatch, missing seed data, or precedence bug -- confirmed via an actual test run, not just code reading
All 4 test blocks (TC-EXP-601-01 through 04) understood as either sharing this root cause or having distinct causes

result.summary: Root cause confirmed for ISS-0617/GH-566: repository_artifacts is a GLOBAL_REGISTRY table whose tenant_default shadow copy should have been dropped by GBL-134 (ISS-0185) but was NOT -- GBL-134's v_tables allow-list covers only 24 of the 37 tables its own diagnosis (ISS-0185-diagnosis.yaml) classifies as GLOBAL, and repository_artifacts is one of the 13 missing. The exp601 test's fixture INSERTs run via TestHarness.conn (search_path=tenant_default,public), so the unqualified INSERT INTO repository_artifacts lands in tenant_default.repository_artifacts instead of public. The resolver (src/config/loader.zig loadConfigArtifact) runs on a pool connection with search_path=public only (LEGACY_RLS mode), so its JOIN against repository_artifacts finds 0 rows even though the matching tenant_artifact_activations row IS correctly in public (that table's shadow WAS dropped by GBL-134). loadActiveQuotaPolicy returns ConfigNotFound, and loadEffectiveQuotaProfile falls through to the platform default (200000) instead of applying the test's override (10). Confirmed via live test run (zig build test-integration-exp601-diag, temporary step) with temporary debug tracing showing tenant_default.repository_artifacts holds the row (count=1) while public.repository_artifacts has 0 matching rows for the same version_id, plus `docker exec ... psql \dt` confirming tenant_default.repository_artifacts exists as a real relation while tenant_default.tenant_artifact_activations does not (correctly dropped). All 4 test blocks share this one root cause: TC-EXP-601-01 hits it directly; TC-EXP-601-02/03/04 call quota_middleware.check, which internally calls the same loadEffectiveQuotaProfile and inherits the same misresolved profile. TC-EXP-601-04 also has a second, distinct PgError.ServerError on an instance_waits INSERT, noted but not traced to file:line precision in this pass -- instance_waits is itself another of the 13 tables missing from GBL-134's array, so it may share the same upstream mechanism; flagged in ISS-0617 for follow-up if it persists after the GBL-134 gap is closed. All temporary debug code (src/config/loader.zig, tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig) and the temporary build.zig diagnostic step were reverted -- git diff on all three files is empty and zig build re-verified clean.
